description:
Podcasts and RSS: listen, read, and download for offline playback PodAura brings podcasts, RSS reading, and audio/video playback together. Features
  • Organize RSS feeds into groups, search articles, and refresh automatically.
  • Play podcast episodes and local audio or video files.
  • Download episodes automatically or in bulk for offline playback.
  • Keep listening with background playback, a mini player, and Picture-in-Picture.
  • Adjust playback speed, choose audio and subtitle tracks, and set a sleep timer.
  • Create playlists and reorder your playback queue.
  • Browse and play episodes by date in the calendar.
  • Read full articles and translate them using your own translation API key.
  • Manage read status, favorites, and playlists in bulk.
  • Customize notifications by feed and group.
  • Import and export subscriptions with OPML.
